name: Deep Dive

categories.label: White pearls collected
categories.hint: Count shells flipped pearl-side up with a white pearl (1 point each); black pearls and empties do not count.

tiebreakers.description: Most white pearls wins; tied players all win.

notes: family: set-collection. Game ends when 4 black-pearl shells are revealed or the shell supply runs out. Shells still face-down in front of a player (not cashed out) are lost. Shell tokens removed for 2-3 players: 10 / 5 white-pearl shells. Rulebook text per RulesPal; the official PDF (BGG file 387748) needs login and was not read, and some rulebook variants (e.g. the 1-player/6-player rules, expansion) were not verified.
